about_the_game:
Built for VR, Made for Friends

HEROES TOGETHER VR is a vibrant VR roguelite packed with co-op exploration, teamwork, and deadly challenges.

The world is broken and Tetherfall stands alone as the last bastion of stability. Join your friends to protect it from the evil Lord Sunder — and just maybe find a way to fight back against the forces of chaos he unleashed.

Unite and Fight Together

Choose from four class options and master your abilities to delve deeper and deeper into an ever-changing world. Swing your sword, shoot your bow, wield powerful magic or trust your own fists to see you through the treacherous world. Experiment and find the playstyle that's right for you — then level it up to unlock all its secrets. Every player brings something new to the team.

Dynamic Procedurally Generated Biomes

Each run recombines rooms, encounters, combat, and loot in new ways. No session will ever be the same, meaning you have to be ready for anything! Drop in with friends or make new ones as you explore multiple intricate biomes together. Through every door lies a new challenge.

Social First

Designed from the ground up as a multiplayer dungeon crawler, Heroes Together VR is tightly balanced around groups of players exploring together. From boss fights to combat encounters to hanging out between sessions, Heroes Together VR is all about... being better together.

VR For Anyone

Drawing from our developers' experience creating VR games that anyone can pick up — yet without compromising on satisfying depth — Heroes Together VR is a game for anyone.

Team up with your friends for never-ending action, quirky minigames, and infinite replayability. Wishlist HEROES TOGETHER VR now to be among the first through the portal when it opens!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 x64
  • Processor: 3 Ghz Quadcore CPU
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1080 / Radeon RX 5700 XT
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Sound Card: N/A
  • VR Support: SteamVR, Meta Quest 3/3S and controllers

short_description: Gather your friends and dive into a world of magic and adventure in HEROES TOGETHER VR, a roguelite VR dungeon crawler. Choose your hero, explore ever-changing biomes, battle magical monsters, and master your skills together as a team in this epic co-op quest.
